title: 2 independent cyclic components with exact weight-indexed admission

claims.statement: The explicit product of 2 cyclic codes, each with 4 degree-125 fields, and its fixed radius-27 adaptive decoder carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 113095139566505723/500000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=1447090668434991280674788701191272669204 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(130089/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), field, orbit count and primitive bound (1), exact weight-indexed child admission (2), and final weighted balance and occupancy (3).
